notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Dockside Extortionist and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
The Dockside Extortionist tokens enter the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Revel in Riches triggers, causing you to win the game.
